items.comments: Very nice house with accommodating host.  I recommend staying with Alan.
Good location, accommodating host, and comfortable bed and pillows. Highly recommend!

This is an amazing location and wonderful place to stay. The host is super accommodating and the house is very recently renovated. The floors, kitchen, and bathroom are super nice. We would definitely stay here again. 5 stars.

Alan managed everything to make my staying awesome. The place is fantastic. Exactly like in the listing, very comfortable bed, spacious and sunny bedroom, a good kitchen, nice bathroom. Everything very clean and organized. Although groceries stores are located 10-15 min walking distance, it's a great neighborhood and you can easily get around with public transportation.
I had a great experience at Alan's place. He was very friendly and accommodating. His place is pretty close to several bus stops and some good restaurants.

Alan's house was lovely and I was so grateful I had such a great home base for my month in Seattle. The whole house is new and well-appointed with everything you could possibly need for your stay. Alan made sure I had everything I needed and made the experience so easy.

Alan was great!  He responded to questions very quickly, was super friendly, and had a great house.  In our specific case, our travel plans changed during our trip, and Alan quickly worked to get us a refund to accommodate us.  Overall, Alan was a pleasure to work with.
